Intro: A pleasure to see you again, kind Chef. I had a wonderful time dining at your establishment. It's been so long since I've done something for myself.
It made me feel like a girl again. Quite foolish for an old woman, but can't a widow enjoy herself a little?
Not like there are any more men to appease in my life. My job as a woman ended with Casmir's death.
This topic has turned quite dreary, my apologies. I'll take my order now.
Success: Thank you, kind Chef. I truly enjoy your work.
Fail: I'm sorry, kind Chef, but today's dish seems off. It is not to my liking.
Reject: Was there something wrong with what I said? I'm sorry, my late husband never let me out the house by myself. Could you give me another chance, please?
